description: This file defines an enumeration 'DepositAccountOnClosureType' representing different options for account closure in the Fineract project, including methods for mapping integer values to enum instances and checking specific closure types.

classes.name: DepositAccountOnClosureType
classes.description: Enumeration of account closure options with associated integer codes and string identifiers, including utility methods for conversion and type checks.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the integer value associated with the closure type.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the string code associated with the closure type.

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Converts an integer to the corresponding DepositAccountOnClosureType enum value.

methods.name: isWithdarwDeposit
methods.description: Checks if the closure type is 'WITHDRAW_DEPOSIT'.

methods.name: isTransferToSavings
methods.description: Checks if the closure type is 'TRANSFER_TO_SAVINGS'.

methods.name: isReinvest
methods.description: Checks if the closure type is either 'REINVEST_PRINCIPAL_AND_INTEREST' or 'REINVEST_PRINCIPAL_ONLY'.

methods.name: isReinvestPrincipal
methods.description: Checks if the closure type is 'REINVEST_PRINCIPAL_ONLY'.

methods.name: isReinvestPrincipalAndInterest
methods.description: Checks if the closure type is 'REINVEST_PRINCIPAL_AND_INTEREST'.

methods.name: isInvalid
methods.description: Checks if the closure type is 'INVALID'.

methods.name: integerValues
methods.description: Returns an array of integer values for all valid closure types, excluding 'INVALID'.
